notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.1
notes.notes:
To keep the game fun and surprising for new players, I won't detail the specific anomalies. This way, new players can experience the game as intended without any spoilers.


 Improved visibility for 4 subtle anomalies (increased by 10-15%).
 Adjusted end-of-corridor conditions to be fairer when you're close to winning.
 Enhanced one very noticeable anomaly to improve its functionality.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes: Fixed a bug with one anomaly not being removed.
